totals.note: The opening is a separate partial workload, not additional work inside the completed fleet search. DLL tracks repeat the same corpus; their work is reported per variant/pass and not added to WASM.

fight.timing: Sum of per-case median ms per fight (four timed three-fight calls per side). Ratio = sum A / sum B, not mean of ratios.
fight.equivalence: Producer compared every timed raw response and both warmups byte-for-byte. SHA-256 is of the raw response, not re-encoded JSON.

fleet.timing: Sum of per-case elapsed lead + score ms; only one traversal per side (per-case median n=1).
fleet.equivalence: Compared pending batches, scores/expanded receipts and completed result. result_sha256 hashes JSON.stringify of the completed A result.
fleet.counts: builds = score-batch measurements (not unique builds); fights and work are those batches, per side, excluding any unreported leader/final work. bytes = requests + responses; carry = returned score receipt bytes, included in transport, not additive.

opening.timing: Sum of per-case elapsed lead + score ms; only one traversal per side (per-case median n=1).
opening.equivalence: Compared first pending batch and measured scores/expanded receipts only; no completed result.
opening.counts: builds = score-batch measurements (not unique builds); fights and work are those batches, per side, excluding any unreported leader/final work. bytes = requests + responses; carry = returned score receipt bytes, included in transport, not additive.

current-api.timing: Sum of per-case median latency / three indexed fights. A timed measurement is one case, not one ABI call. Work/gas refer to one logical pass; preflight/warmup excluded.

accepted-api.timing: Sum of per-case median latency / three indexed fights. A timed measurement is one case, not one ABI call. Work/gas refer to one logical pass; preflight/warmup excluded.

accepted-prepared.scope: Short-row score, metric, work and counts; not a published board score. The opaque prepared ABI does not return individual shards.
accepted-prepared.timing: Sum of per-case median latency / three indexed fights. A timed measurement is one case, not one ABI call. Work/gas refer to one logical pass; preflight/warmup excluded.
